summary: Clarified that group artifacts are read via their own top-level job-state.json/prd.json/findings (same schema as jobs), so the existing 10-case predicate covers them; dropped the unused groupState parameter from the predicate signature and ambient decl, and added a group-as-job acceptance-criterion test case.

Added jobDirMarker?: true to the deriveRalphStage bundle (scripts.d.ts + JSDoc), rewrote predicate #8 to test the marker, and assigned sync-core the responsibility of setting it when a jobDir/groupDir is observed without prd.json or job-state.json.

Expanded scripts.d.ts spec to declare all three test-imported modules (derive-ralph-stage, sync-core, resolve-config) using explicit relative-path module specifiers (not the wildcard `*/...mjs` form, which does not resolve relative imports under moduleResolution=bundler); offered typed dynamic import as a per-module alternative; updated the matching acceptance criterion, the ralphStage.test.ts file description, and the cascade-refresh checkbox to stay in lockstep.

Finding is stale — the draft-plan.md already has `loadConfig({ repoRoot, configPath? })`, a dedicated 'Canonical precedence' block (lines 266-271) defining merge order vs. committed-path lookup, explicit resolution of the env-var+overlay case, and an AC (line 460) that mirrors the resolver section. The contradiction the reviewer described matches the prior existing-plan.md revision, not the current draft.
Added Verification step L: grep -F '.ralph/overview-config.local.json' .gitignore must exit 0, closing the gap between the acceptance criterion and verification.

Defined REVIEW_PHASES and IMPLEMENTING_PHASES constants explicitly, rewrote predicate #6 to enumerate the complement (including 5c) and pin unknown/future phase strings to `implementing` with a stderr lint, updated the RalphStage type comment, and added parametrized + unknown-phase test cases to acceptance criteria.

Amended four locations (Technical Constraints, Files-to-Modify schema bullet, Schema-block JSONC note, Common Mistake #8) to state explicitly that BOTH overview-config.json AND overview-config.schema.json must be pure JSON; JSONC code blocks in the plan are illustrative only; prose belongs in the sibling README.

Specified JS-sidecar idempotency comparison (trusted-eval parse + strip top-level generatedAt + deep-equal, or via JS↔JSON consistency) and resolved the per-entry generatedAt question by forbidding it on RalphPipelineState in Plan 01; updated AC, Verification D, type model, and the soft-cap entry.

Trimmed the Configuration-layer JSONC example to only the fields Plan 01 consumes; added a 'Downstream additive extensions' subsection listing each deferred field with its owning plan (02/03/04/05/07/08/11); marked F-009 RESOLVED in the soft-cap section.

Assigned generatedFromCommit computation to the CLI (scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs) via a parallel `git rev-parse --short HEAD` call, threaded it into walkRalphState's signature so it's stamped onto OverviewRalphState, and specified the 'unknown' fallback with stderr warning for any HEAD-resolution failure. Marked F-010 RESOLVED in the soft-cap list.
